as_told.title: Hoagland's Dark Mission: NASA as an occult organisation

plain: NASA has hidden a secret history, including signs of past life on Mars, and runs on something like occult ritual, according to Dark Mission: The Secret History of NASA, a book by Richard Hoagland that Jesse Michels himself calls 'very controversial.' Michels brings it up in two episodes about Mars, once saying it makes 'similar claims' to those of his guest and once that it portrays NASA as 'some like occult, ritualistic' organisation.
